headline: New coding models to test, local inference to evaluate, and supply-chain caution urged

calls.title: Test new Microsoft coding models for engineering
calls.text: Test MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot to accelerate data pipeline engineering and coding tasks.

calls.title: Evaluate local Indian inference API for pipelines
calls.text: Benchmark Sarvam AI's domestic Token Factory API for latency and cost against current cloud inference setups to process financial data locally.

calls.title: Audit agent dependencies after supply chain compromise
calls.text: Immediately audit and lock down all dependencies used in agentic workflow development following the PyPI credential stealer compromise.
